prompt:
Locked-off camera. His feet stay planted on the wet paving; he does not step or walk, and his shadow stays joined to his boots. His knees give a small, quick bounce under heavy weight. His upturned palm jabs forward once at waist height, like a man asking, then snaps shut into a fist and pumps down twice, stopping dead. His other hand hangs by his thigh. His upper body rocks forward on each pump and his head bobs hard. Sound: river water lapping the wall, a distant siren.

Thanks.
